title: When the Hymn Turns
author: Quentin Sterling
blurb: Wendell Vasquez, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
